description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeTimesheetAPI class in the OrangeHRM Time API. It tests various API endpoints such as create, get all, update, get one, and delete, mainly aimed at functional and integration testing within the HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to test the EmployeeTimesheetAPI functionality for the OrangeHRM Time module, including create, retrieve, update, and handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of an employee timesheet via the API, utilizing data provider for multiple cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testCreate' method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee timesheets via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee timesheet via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
